thread:
maria: FYI SCA (depscan) flagged libimgproc 3.2.1 -> CVE-2025-1234 in CI even though we vendor-patched and recompiled. Looks like a fingerprint-only match. Can I get risk-acceptance for a short allowlist while we finish the cleanup?

ana: Can you drop the raw SCA output + repo path so we can confirm it's a false positive?

maria: Sure — output below from GitHub Actions run on infra/image-builder: 
```
depscan: libimgproc 3.2.1 matched CVE-2025-1234
path: infra/image-builder/vendor/libimgproc
match_type: package-name-only
advisory_link: https://oss-advisories.example/CVE-2025-1234
note: our fork contains upstream patch backported at commit 9f1c2d
```

ryan: Quick read: upstream advisory says vuln affects 2.x series only and was fixed in 3.0. But SCA sometimes misattributes when vendored. If you have the backport commit hash that's strong evidence.

olivia: Runtime mitigations: image-builder runs in a constrained builder container (no network egress), and artifacts are scanned again at publish time. We also have WAF rules that block the known exploit vector at the edge.

maria: Proposal: temporary allowlist entry in depscan for this path (infra/image-builder/vendor/libimgproc) for 7 days, owner @maria. Requirements: (1) add entry to security exception log, (2) open a remediation ticket and PR to remove vendored copy or ship a clean upstream dep, (3) Datadog monitor for any exploit indicators.

jamie: +1 to the proposal. Please ensure the exception log record lists compensating controls and expiration. Also require a follow-up assigned engineer.

vuln-bot: Auto-ticket created: SEC-2025-78 — "Investigate libimgproc CVE-2025-1234 vendor backport". SLA: 7 days. Reminder at day 5.

ana: I approve temporary risk acceptance for 7 days given the evidence and compensating controls (:white_check_mark:). Conditions: owner set, entry in exception registry, PR opened within 24h, monitoring added. I'll sign off on closure after remediation.

maria: Done — added entry to /security/acceptance.csv with fields: repo=infra/image-builder, path=vendor/libimgproc, cve=CVE-2025-1234, owner=maria, expires=1773163688 (7d), rationale="vendor backport + runtime containment". PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/432 (links SEC-2025-78). :lock:

ryan: Note for records: KMS keys/rotation not impacted here, no secrets change required. Mentioned because some reviewers ask for KMS notes on exception entries.

olivia: I'll add a Datadog synthetic monitor and an IDS rule for the specific exploit signature. I'll post monitor ID in SEC-2025-78.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up if SCA updates its signature. If remediation slips, vuln-bot will escalate. Ping @ana if you need a longer extension.

ana: Thanks — logging approval and closure conditions. :thumbsup:
